On the 'Bench Board' board (project_id=1) I used the Backlog column's "Add a new task" dialog, filled Title = "fwkb26-n2 Bench Task" and Description = "Bench task for run fwkb26-n2", and clicked Save; the page then reported "Task created successfully." and the Backlog column count went from 3 to 4. The task page (/?controller=TaskViewController&action=show&task_id=4) renders as "Bench Board, #4 - fwkb26-n2 Bench Task" with heading "Task #4", heading "fwkb26-n2 Bench Task" and the description text "Bench task for run fwkb26-n2", so the assigned numeric ID is 4. The three pre-existing tasks ("Seed: triage inbox" #1, "Seed: order missing parts" #2, "Seed: ship repaired device" #3) were left untouched — they still appear on the board with their original titles after creation.
